thread:
Maya (GTM PM): thanks everyone for joining the all-hands recap thread — a few quick follow-ups from the partner & pipeline section. can leadership clarify next steps on the 3 strategic partner plays we called out?
Diego (Head of Sales): +1. specifically: 1) timing for co-sell enablement kit, 2) discount approval flow for pilot deals, 3) who owns intro handoffs to the partner SEs.
Ethan (Partner Sales): for the co-sell kit i can own the initial content. need marketing + product review. timeline: target next Wed for draft.
Maya (GTM PM): thanks Ethan. @Sam can you confirm if marketing has bandwidth next week? also, on discount flow — Jordan, can we get clarity on thresholds for approval vs exec signoff?
Sam (Sales Ops): marketing is +1 for a lightweight kit next week (1 pager + demo script). i'll slot a review slot on tues 11am.
Jordan (Finance): discount thresholds: up to 20% can be approved by Head of Sales (Diego). 20-35% needs RevOps exec approval. >35% requires CFO signoff. if a partner-sourced opportunity expects >35% discount, we need a short biz-case doc.
Diego (Head of Sales): noted. Sam — pls create a simple template for the biz-case doc (ARR, strategic value, co-sell credit).
Maya (GTM PM): on handoffs — proposal: partner-sourced leads go to Partner Sales (Ethan) for qualifier, then to AE with a partner badge. is that OK?
Ethan (Partner Sales): yes, that mirrors current practice. request: please add a field in HubSpot for partner-touchpoint timestamp so we can report conversion lag.
Sam (Sales Ops): can add a custom field. will roll out to a pilot team this week.
Ava (CEO): appreciate the clarity. one ask from leadership: highlight any top-3 at-risk deals from partners by EOD Friday so we can help remove blockers.
Diego (Head of Sales): i'll compile and share a short list tomorrow morning.
Maya (GTM PM): action items summary:
• Ethan: co-sell kit draft by Wed
• Sam: schedule marketing review Tue 11am + add HubSpot partner-touchpoint field
• Jordan: finalize discount thresholds (shared here) + confirm biz-case template requirements
• Diego: deliver top-3 at-risk partner deals by Friday EOD + own 20% discount approvals
• Maya: consolidate notes + create shared doc for follow-ups (<link to doc will be posted here>)
All-Hands-Bot: reminder set for Tue 11:00 for co-sell kit review. :bell:
Diego (Head of Sales): quick Q — for dedicated capacity deals, do we offer trial credits or only pricing discounts? want to align with partner handoffs.
Jordan (Finance): trial credits are ok for pilots under $50k TCV; larger pilots default to discounted reserved pricing or customer-funded POC. send specific asks to finance@redwood.com.
Maya (GTM PM): perfect. i'll post the shared tracking doc here after Diego sends the at-risk list. thanks all for the quick responses! :raised_hands:
